steps.content: Time seems to stretch on. Sweat trickles down your spine. Your knuckles turn white from clenching too hard, and your shoulders ache from prolonged tension.
Then, you see it, the true form of a distant shadow—a patch of water that undulates gently against the current, surrounded by waves going the different way.
It must be land! You look down in excitement, eager to share the good news with Shin on the deck below, when a strange dizziness suddenly crashes over you.
Your vision begins to distort. You blink hard, trying to stay sober, but in the corner of your eye, that patch of water slowly splits open.

You see something slowly emerging from the rift. It is one with the sea, its form indescribable, its size unknowable. You can only instinctively feel that it has countless twisted limbs and chaotic, disordered eyes.
The land on the horizon is completely obscured. All you can see is the ancient, colossal being, looming with a nameless malice. Moving, coming for you, eroding your very consciousness...
Darkness engulfs you, dragging you down into the bottomless deep.
